review.images: Aldar’s Rosso Bay presentation section supplies the waterfront exterior, entrance, clubhouse and fitness room. Provident’s dedicated Rosso Bay project gallery supplies the alternate tower angle and full interior renders, which match the colour scheme and room previews in the official material board. Nikki Beach imagery and shared generic images were excluded.
review.location: Aldar’s joint presentation includes a regional map with the four estimates on physical page 3 and a project-specific colour-coded site plan on physical page 6. The airport is labelled Dubai Airport in that source. Nikki Beach’s separate brochure uses a different airport estimate, which was not substituted.
review.floorPlans: Official presentation pages 43–46 contain four Rosso Bay drawings. The red Madena technical PDF repeats those layouts. Four Property Finder furnished examples have individually listed areas. The corresponding technical sheets do not print a whole-home area. Propjunction supplies the distinctly labelled Type 3B furnished drawing without a published area. The 1A and 2A portal technical images repeat the brochure. The Property Finder technical 3A Version 2 drawing matches the Nikki Beach plan on page 25 of Aldar’s joint presentation rather than Rosso Bay page 45, so was excluded. Five-bedroom Sky Terrace appears under Nikki Beach in the combined presentation and is not assigned to Rosso Bay.
